title: Command menu
description: A search palette for jumping to commands, opened with a keyboard shortcut. Icons react as you move through the commands with the mouse or the arrow keys.
iconsNote: The icons in this menu use the default Hover state, so any System Outline or System Solid icon will fit. Stick with the default animation, as In, Morph and Loop states don’t work well here.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: The search field
fragments.note: The arrow keys move through the list while you keep typing.

fragments.title: The rows
fragments.note: A listbox of options. data-choose marks a row that can be chosen and arrowed to.

fragments.title: The keyboard shortcut
fragments.note: togglePopover() on the panel. The button is not involved.

fragments.title: Filter the rows
fragments.note: hidden on the rows; the empty state gets data-shown for its icon.

fragments.title: Open empty
fragments.note: The palette opens fresh every time, without a flash of the last search.

fragments.title: Hide empty groups
fragments.note: Whether a group still has a visible row is a question CSS can ask with :has().
